situation.title: Operation Market: Nijmegen
situation.dateStatus: As printed on the game card; not independent historical verification

usage: Schema-validated Situation reference and hex setup-planning package. First-pass map interpretation is not engine-admitted terrain.

briefing: Elements of U.S. 82nd Airborne Division and Irish Guards assault German 9th SS Panzer Division at Nijmegen. Formations and date as printed, not independently verified historical strengths.
victory: Allied victory: control two bridge hexes north of hex row Q at game end, including a tank bridge if emplaced and intact.
German victory: prevent the Allied condition.

objectives: Allied victory: control two bridge hexes north of hex row Q at game end, including a tank bridge if emplaced and intact.
German victory: prevent the Allied condition.
